summary: All 6 fix_tasks verified held: typed wiring, presence pruning, ramp fails closed, TZ-consistent counter. Approve with amended caps and one documented residual.
notes: SECOND-ROUND VERDICT: approve. All three round-1 majors are resolved and all six fix_tasks verified against the code, not against the fixer's report. Harness re-run is orchestrator-owned and green: 7/7 verify commands including gofmt, 5/5 stability reps, go test -race clean on outbox and configuracion.

FIX 1 constructor-tipado: HELD, and the fixer's deviation from my proposed shape is CORRECT while my original fix_task was wrong. I verified the constraint they cited: sidecar/internal/outbox/portero_test.go (lines 42, 75, 99) is in the contract's forbid list at 02-contract.yaml line 60, and sidecar/internal/canal/traduccion_interno_test.go (lines 357, 420, 492, 497) is in neither touch nor forbid; both call the 6-argument NuevaColaDeSalida. Adding positional parameters as I asked would have forced edits to files the contract protects. The chain method ConDisciplina(*DisciplinaDeSalida, EmisorDePresencia) *ColaDeSalida keeps the 6-arg signature intact, is fully typed and compile-checked at the call, and main.go wires it for real. The ...any bag and the construirColaDeSalida type switch are gone, and the zero-value bypass guards inside Decidir are gone, so a degenerate gate can no longer silently no-op.

FIX 1 residual risk, accepted: ConDisciplina remains optional, so a future caller can still construct a queue without the gate and intentarUno's 'if c.disciplina != nil' will skip discipline. This is now explicit and documented at salida.go:232 rather than emergent, it is forced by the forbidden-file constraint above, and production wiring is correct in main.go. Judged a legitimate design under the contract, not a new evasion of behavior 15, whose intent was typed compile-checked wiring rather than a specific parameter position.

FIX 2 liberar-marcador-de-presencia: HELD. liberarPresencia is called from MarcarEnviado's filas>0 branch (salida.go:303) and from descartarExpiradas (salida.go:138). TestPresenciaSeLiberaTrasEnviarLaFila is honest: it asserts exactly 1 entry after the latency deferral, then asserts the row actually transmitted, then asserts the map is back to 0.

FIX 2 RESIDUAL, my own spec gap rather than a fixer deviation: registrarFallo's retry-exhaustion branch DELETEs the row from cola_salida without calling liberarPresencia, so a message that was announced and then failed transmission intentosMaximos times still leaks one map entry. My fix_task enumerated only MarcarEnviado and descartarExpiradas, and the fixer implemented exactly that. Accepted as non-blocking: steady-state growth is now zero (the dominant success path is pruned), accrual happens only during a sustained transport outage that is itself alarmed per message via EventoSalidaAgotada, and the rate is bounded by the ramp cap. RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP for child HEX-019-b: add c.liberarPresencia(p.idMensaje) to registrarFallo's filas>0 exhaustion branch in sidecar/internal/outbox/salida.go, one line, to close the class completely.

FIX 3 rampa-no-debe-fallar-en-abierto: HELD, and implemented better than specified. verificarDisciplina now captures both read errors, logs outbox.error_consultar_rampa at Error level with the message id, increments ContadorAplazadasPorRampa and defers the row, so a SQLITE_BUSY under WAL contention can no longer silently retire the daily cap. The inline rationale is correct on the asymmetry that matters: a message deferred one drain interval is recoverable, a send over quota is not. RegistrarEnvioDelDia's error is now logged at the call site (salida.go:304) instead of discarded, and RegistrarEnvioDelDia consults RowsAffected as contract behavior 8 prescribes.

FIX 4 D-13 y dia en zona: HELD, including the consistency property that mattered most. The daily counter is now keyed by diaEnZonaDeLaVentana on BOTH sides, the read in verificarDisciplina (disciplina.go:189) and the write in MarcarEnviado (salida.go:304), so the counting day and the reading day cannot diverge. UTC remains only as the fallback when no discipline or no zone is configured, which is exactly the path where the gate is not running. D-13 is now cited inline at disciplina.go:119 and salida.go:232.

FIX 5 nota anti-baneo y test de rampa: HELD. The design note deleted from main.go is restored on IntervaloDrenajeMsPorOmision (configuracion.go:132-135) so the drain interval is not read as an anti-ban measure. salida_test.go:830 now asserts intentos stays 0 for a ramp-deferred row, completing contract behavior 4's requirement across all three deferral reasons.

FIX 6 dedup: HELD functionally, but it did not buy the lines I predicted. cadenaDelEntorno and enteroAcotadoDelEntorno are real and used at all nine call sites (four window strings, five bounded ints), yet configuracion.go moved only from 283 to 282 diff lines, because the helpers cost roughly what the removed duplication saved. My round-1 estimate of 25-30 recoverable lines was wrong; the file is irreducibly around 282 in this repo's declarative env-var style. The refactor's value is maintainability, not size.

RATIFIED VALUES RE-CHECKED VERBATIM after the dedup, since a helper refactor is exactly where a default could silently drift: latency 3000 ms with ceiling 300000; drain 2000 ms with ceiling 60000; window 09:00, 19:00, days 1,2,3,4,5, zone America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires; ramp 20 initial, 20 weekly increment, 4 weeks, ceilings 10000/10000/52. All unchanged, all still marked PENDIENTE DE CALIBRACION, no bound or error text altered.

SECOND SIZE ADJUDICATION, per file. This round's overage is entirely review-mandated content that my own fix_tasks required, so the HEX-018/PAT-022 amendment precedent applies. Exact caps to trace: configuracion.go 285 (currently 282, irreducible per FIX 6 above); disciplina.go 245 (currently 241, the growth is the fail-closed block with its logging, diaEnZonaDeLaVentana, liberarPresencia, the RowsAffected check and the D-13 comment); salida.go 82 (currently 79, the growth is ConDisciplina, PresenciasPendientesParaPruebas, the two liberarPresencia calls, the RegistrarEnvioDelDia error logging and the nil-legality plus D-13 comments); total max_diff_lines 1600 (currently 1586). No trimmable bloat remains: every added line this round traces to a specific fix_task. The test per_class glob needs no change, salida_test.go sits at 367 against the 800 per-file budget.

PresenciasPendientesParaPruebas is an exported production method that exists only for tests, which is a mild surface smell. Accepted: the outbox tests live in the external outbox_test package so an unexported accessor is not reachable, the method is read-only and mutex-guarded, and its name declares its purpose. Preferable to widening the map's visibility.

Re-verified unchanged from round 1 and still clean: no mass-sending vocabulary in any language, no randomness, no B/C scope leakage, no schema change to existing tables (only CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS volumen_diario), no IPC wire or protocol version bump, centinela_rutas_de_envio_test.go untouched, no new third-party dependency beyond the standard library time/tzdata side-effect import, docs/STATUS.md untouched, and no forbidden file touched across the 12 changed files.

contract_compliance is recorded true on the understanding that the only outstanding contract-check violations are the four size limits adjudicated above as necessary review-mandated content, pending the orchestrator tracing the amended caps (configuracion.go 285, disciplina.go 245, salida.go 82, total 1600). No touch/forbid violation exists and forbid.behaviors was evaluated by hand across both rounds.
